```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

## A minimal showcase deck

This deck exists purely to give `oxview::ox_view_pptx()` something real to
preview, produced by knitting this file with **R Markdown**.

## A table slide

```{r}
knitr::kable(mtcars[1:5, 1:4])
```

## A plot slide

```{r}
plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg, main = "Weight vs mpg", xlab = "wt (1000 lbs)", ylab = "mpg")
```
